title: Soil        Site Classification
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the cohesion among soil particles and adhesion of soil to other substances or the resistance of the soil to deformation."
Consistence refers to the cohesion among soil particles and adhesion of soil to other substances or the resistance of the soil to deformation.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to designate specific features within master horizons."
Lower case letters are used to designate specific features within master horizons.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the amount of sand, silt, and clay in a soil sample."
Texture refers to the amount of sand, silt, and clay in a soil sample.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the arrangement of soil particles."
Structure refers to the arrangement of soil particles.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the product of processes that aggregate, cement, compact or unconsolidated soil material."
Soil structure is the product of processes that aggregate, cement, compact or unconsolidated soil material.
fib: ______ refers to the degree of contrast between two adjoining horizons and the thickness of the transition between them.
Distinctness refers to the degree of contrast between two adjoining horizons and the thickness of the transition between them.
______ are a meaningful and comparable schema for sample collection (see graphic).
soil horizons are a meaningful and comparable schema for sample collection (see graphic).
______ refers to the shape or degree of irregularity of the boundary.
Topography refers to the shape or degree of irregularity of the boundary.
______ are the base symbols to which other characters are added in order to complete the designation.
The capital letters are the base symbols to which other characters are added in order to complete the designation.
